messages:
Marta: Weekly health check — need p95/p99 tail by route+model, streaming vs sync for Pinehaven trial. Flag anything >2x week-over-week, renewals/usage/spend notes. cc @devon @ashley @praveen :eyes:

Devon: Quick snapshot (UTC window: last 7d)
```
Route    Model              Streaming p95 / p99   Sync p95 / p99   WoW p99 delta
/chat    redwood-2.1        380ms / 1.2s          140ms / 420ms     +80% (streaming p99)
/chat    rw-quant-7b        290ms / 850ms          110ms / 320ms     +5%
/complete openlm-3b         120ms / 410ms          95ms / 300ms      -2%
/embed   redwood-2.1        90ms / 220ms           85ms / 200ms      +10%
```
Notes: Pinehaven streaming p99 for /chat jumped to 1.2s vs 670ms last week. Token volume for streaming doubled; total spend +3.1x on trial bucket.

Ashley: I saw the same. Correlated with last config rollout — prefix caching disabled for streaming to troubleshoot ordering bug.
Ashley: deploy log snippet:
```
kubectl set env deploy/inference-service STREAMING_PREFIX_CACHE=false --namespace=dedicated-pinehaven
```
Ashley: That disables prefix/KV cache; explains >2x tail increase on long-context chats.

Praveen: Infra noise as well — between 03:12-03:20 UTC we had 2x g4dn node restarts in pinehaven pool. Incident ids: inc-8421, inc-8422. GPU eviction + small queueing spike.
Praveen: I will repro the node failure locally and check driver logs.

HealthBot: Alert: rolling restart detected in pool dedicated-pinehaven at 03:14 UTC. Aggregate 99th latency spike +62% during incident window.

Marta: Ok — action plan?
Devon: 1) Re-enable STREAMING_PREFIX_CACHE on canary (2 nodes) and run synthetic long-context stream tests (5k tokens). 2) Patch operator to avoid evicting KV on small restarts. 3) Reach out to Pinehaven with note on expected impact + remediation ETA.
Ashley: I'll flip the canary now and monitor. Will post perf diffs in 10m.
Praveen: I'll follow up on node restarts and add extra liveness tolerances to avoid eviction thrash.

Marta: Ping @devon for updated cost breakdown and craft a short note for AMs: explain spike, reassure on fix + ask if they'd like a cost-optimization review.
Devon: Will send draft to channel before EOD.

Ashley: Canary results: streaming p99 dropped to 430ms on canary with cache enabled. Sync unchanged.
Ashley: Patch looks good, preparing rollout.

Marta: Thanks — tagged as high priority for Pinehaven renewal health. Will update CS notes.
